label: main
note: main 76ac433 (M0 + M1.1-1.3) plus the harness; runtime code identical to main

backend.name: postgres
backend.version: PostgreSQL 18.6 (Debian 18.6-1.pgdg12+2) on x86_64-pc-linux-gnu, compiled by gcc (Debian 12.2.0-14+deb12u1) 12.2.0, 64-bit

machine.topology: single cloud VM; the benchmark client, actor runtime, and database share its CPUs; database over loopback TCP

scenarios.name: hot-actor
scenarios.description: Warm command turns on one actor: sequential latency, then 8 and 64 concurrent callers competing for its single turn slot.

scenarios.name: query-latency
scenarios.description: Query handler reads of committed state: sequential on one actor, then 64 concurrent callers over 1k actors.

scenarios.name: receipt-replay
scenarios.description: Same-command-id retries of committed commands: sequential replay latency, then 64 concurrent replayers.

scenarios.name: state-size
scenarios.description: State growing toward the default maxStateBytes (65,536): rewrite the blob every turn, hold it while touching a counter, and wake an actor that stores it.

scenarios.name: many-actors
scenarios.description: 64 concurrent callers over 1k/10k/100k actors: first touch (create + activate each actor once), then uniform steady-state load over warm activations, then a connection-pool sweep at 10k actors.
